1	# Polyglot
2	
3	Central management dashboard for all your Claude Code agents across every project.
4	
5	## What it does
6	
7	- **See all agents in one place** — global agents + every project's sub-agents
8	- **Create/edit/delete agents** — both global and per-project, from one UI
9	- **Edit CLAUDE.md files** — global and per-project, with save
10	- **Copy agents between projects** — or promote a project agent to global
11	- **View slash commands** — see and edit all /commands per project
12	- **Auto-discover projects** — scans your project folders automatically
13	
14	## Install
15	
16	```bash
17	# Clone or copy the polyglot folder to anywhere on your Mac
18	cd polyglot
19	npm install
20	npm start
21	```
22	
23	Open http://localhost:3847 in your browser.
24	
25	## First run
26	
27	1. Polyglot asks you to add project directories (e.g. `~/projects`)
28	2. It scans those folders for any project with `.claude/` or `CLAUDE.md`
29	3. You see everything — all agents, all rules, all projects in one dashboard
30	
31	## How it works
32	
33	Polyglot reads and writes the same files that Claude Code uses:
34	
35	```
36	~/.claude/CLAUDE.md          ← global rules (edit in Polyglot)
37	~/.claude/agents/*.md        ← global agents (edit in Polyglot)
38	~/projects/app1/CLAUDE.md    ← app rules (edit in Polyglot)
39	~/projects/app1/.claude/agents/*.md  ← app sub-agents (edit in Polyglot)
40	```
41	
42	When you edit in Polyglot → the file changes on disk → Claude Code picks it up next session. Real-time sync.
43	
44	## Requirements
45	
46	- Node.js 18+
47	- macOS (or Linux/Windows)
48

1	# Polyglot SDK Specification — Agent Dispatch & Observability System
2	
3	> **Status:** Production Design Spec (Ready for Implementation)
4	> **Scope:** Boldteq agents ONLY (internal agent-to-agent calls, not external APIs)
5	> **Component of:** Boldteq Software Factory v2 (2026-04)
6	> **Dashboard Host:** Polyglot Hub (Next.js 16 on Railway)
7	> **Database:** Supabase `agent-ops` (separate from app databases)
8	> **Last Updated:** 2026-04-14
9	
10	---
11	
12	## Overview
13	
14	**Polyglot SDK** enables all 22+ Boldteq agents to:
15	1. **Dispatch tasks to each other** — call another agent programmatically
16	2. **Emit observability events** — full audit trail of every action
17	3. **Track execution metrics** — performance, cost, gates, retries
18	4. **Self-manage lifecycle** — promotions, PIPs, training integration
19	5. **Provide dashboards** — leaderboards, run history, pattern reviews, cost tracking
20	
21	The SDK is a **TypeScript module** (`@boldteq/polyglot`) that every agent imports and uses at initialization. It reads/writes to a dedicated Supabase project (`agent-ops`) which is independent from application databases.
22	
23	---
24	
25	## Architecture Overview
26	
27	```
28	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
29	│              Polyglot Hub Dashboard                          │
30	│        (Next.js 16.2.3 on Railway, public UI)               │
31	│  - Agent leaderboard (composite scores, levels, xp)        │
32	│  - Run history (timeline, filters, search)                  │
33	│  - Event stream (real-time, all observability)             │
34	│  - Training logs (patches applied, impact scores)          │
35	│  - Pattern review queue (awaiting Yash approval)           │
36	│  - Cost dashboard (per-agent, per-model, trends)           │
37	│  - HR decisions (promotions, PIPs, retirements)            │
38	│  - Incident reports (traced to specific agent runs)        │
39	└─────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┘
40	                      │ reads from
41	                      ▼
42	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
43	│             Supabase agent-ops (private)                     │
44	│  Separate from app databases. 15 tables:                    │
45	│  - agents                                                   │
46	│  - agent_runs                                               │
47	│  - agent_events                                             │
48	│  - agent_gates                                              │
49	│  - agent_delegations                                        │
50	│  - agent_costs                                              │
51	│  - agent_patterns                                           │
52	│  - agent_files                                              │
53	│  - agent_reviews (HR)                                       │
54	│  - training_applied                                         │
55	│  - training_logs                                            │
56	│  - incident_reports                                         │
57	│  - [+ support tables: orgs, api_keys, activity_logs]        │
58	└─────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┘
59	                      │ written by
60	                      ▼
61	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
62	│        @boldteq/polyglot SDK (TypeScript 5.x)               │
63	│    Installed at ~/.claude/sdk/polyglot/ (Git submodule)     │
64	│                                                              │
65	│  Modules:                                                    │
66	│  - client.ts      → PolyglotClient class                    │
67	│  - dispatch.ts    → Agent-to-agent RPC                      │
68	│  - events.ts      → Event emission & schema validation      │
69	│  - tracking.ts    → RunTracker class                        │
70	│  - costs.ts       → Cost logging (token accounting)         │
71	│  - patterns.ts    → Pattern usage tracking                  │
72	│  - types.ts       → Full TypeScript interfaces              │
73	│  - index.ts       → Public exports                          │
74	└─────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┘
75	                      │ imported by
76	                      ▼
77	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
78	│          All 22+ Boldteq Agents                              │
79	│                                                              │
80	│  Required integration per agent:                            │
81	│  1. Import @boldteq/polyglot at start of every run          │
82	│  2. Call initPolyglot(config) with agentId                  │
83	│  3. Create RunTracker for every task                        │
84	│  4. Emit task_started, gate results, file changes           │
85	│  5. Log cost at end (model, tokens, USD)                    │
86	│  6. Call run.end() which inserts agent_run + computes score │
87	│                                                              │
88	│  Agents (22):                                               │
89	│  Scout, Vex, Sage | Atlas, Arya, Riko, Ledger |            │
90	│  Rex, Nova, Koda, Dato, Luna, Quill, Vega, Zeph |          │
91	│  Echo, Mira, Bolt, Hawk | Orbit, Pulse, Verdict |          │
92	│  Cadence, Roster, Witness, Forge, Tutor                    │
93	└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
94	```
95	
96	### Data Flow Example: Koda Builds a Feature
97	
98	```
99	Koda starts a feature build task:
100	
101	1. Koda imports @boldteq/polyglot
102	2. Koda calls initPolyglot({ agentId: KODA_UUID, agentName: 'koda' })
103	3. Koda creates RunTracker('feature_build')
104	4. run.start() → emits task_started event
105	5. Koda builds the feature
106	6. Koda needs schema → calls poly.dispatch({ targetAgent: 'dato', taskType: 'create_table', ... })
107	7. Dato returns table name, Koda logs logDelegation('dato', 'create_table', true)
108	8. Koda runs tsc, lint, build → run.addGateResult('tsc_no_emit', true), etc.
109	9. Koda modifies 5 files → run.addFileChange('src/app/dashboard/page.tsx') × 5
110	10. Koda runs tests → run.addGateResult('test', true)
111	11. Koda logs costs → poly.logCost({ model: 'claude-opus-4-6', inputTokens: 45000, ... })
112	12. Koda calls run.end() which:
113	    - Inserts to agent_runs table
114	    - Inserts all collected events
115	    - Computes composite_score (gates, retries, cost)
116	    - Returns AgentRun with metrics
117	13. Polyglot Hub dashboard updates in real-time
118	14. Mira loads the run, extracts lessons, updates memory brain
119	```
120	
121	---
122

Based on my thorough exploration of the Polyglot project, here's what I found:

---

## POLYGLOT TODAY: Complete Architecture Analysis

### **1. What is Polyglot?**

**Polyglot is a hybrid system with three components:**

- **Desktop Dashboard** (React + Vite) — local web UI at `http://localhost:3847` (port 3847)
- **Express.js Server** (Node.js 18+) — local-only REST API with SQLite backend
- **SDK Module** (`@boldteq/agents`) — npm package at `/Polyglot/sdk/` for inter-project agent calls
- **VS Code Extension** — Built but not actively integrated (`/vscode-extension/`)

**Status:** Fully functional local-only system running on your Mac. NO cloud hosting yet.

---

### **2. Current Architecture**

#### **Server Layer** (`/src/server.js`)
- **Port:** 3847
- **Entry:** `npm start` → spawns `node src/server.js`
- **Security:** Middleware enforces `localhost`/`127.0.0.1` ONLY (see `/src/middleware/localOnly.js`)
  - Exception: Webhooks (`/api/webhooks/trigger/*`) can be called externally with secret validation
- **Framework:** Express.js with 20+ route modules
- **Build:** React client pre-built to `/public-dist/` (fallback to `/public/`)

#### **Database Layer** (`/src/db.js`)
- **Type:** SQLite (better-sqlite3) synchronous
- **Location:** `data/polyglot.db` (created on first run)
- **Schema:** 15+ tables tracking:
  - `agent_runs` — execution history (indexed by agent, timestamp, status)
  - `run_history` — orchestration workflow logs
  - `witness_log` — audit trail of all events
  - `daily_scores` — agent performance metrics
  - `agents` — agent definitions & profiles
  - Plus: schedules, claims, webhooks, training, memory patterns, org/HR data
- **Migrations:** 3 migrations applied at startup (create tables, import JSON, changelog)

#### **File Watchers & State** (`/src/backup.js`)
- **Chokidar file watcher** monitors `~/.claude/` for changes:
  - Watches: `agents/`, `memory/`, `rules/`, `commands/`, `CLAUDE.md`, `settings.json`
  - Debounce: 5 seconds + 15-minute safety-net commit
  - Backs up to GitHub repo (`https://github.com/boldteq/polyglot.git`)
  - Token encrypted with machine-local AES-256-GCM key

#### **Client** (`/client/`)
- **Framework:** React 19.2.4 + TypeScript
- **UI Build:** Vite
- **Editor:** TipTap rich text (markdown support)
- **Graph Visualization:** XYFlow for orchestration diagrams
- **No real-time subscriptions:** All data fetched via REST polling

---

### **3. Communication Architecture**

#### **Current (Local-Only)**
```
Your Mac
├─ Polyglot Server (localhost:3847)
│  ├─ Express API
│  ├─ SQLite DB (data/polyglot.db)
│  └─ File watchers (chokidar → ~/.claude/)
├─ React Browser UI (http://localhost:3847)
└─ Agent SDK (@boldteq/agents)
   └─ Calls Polyglot via fetch() to http://localhost:3847/api/*
```

#### **Communication Mechanisms (All Local)**
1. **REST API** — fetch() calls from browser & SDK
   - Server-Sent Events (SSE) for long-running agent execution (`/api/playground/run`)
   - Typical timeout: 120s with 90s idle detection
2. **File System** — Chokidar watches + atomic writes
3. **SQLite** — Local synchronous database
4. **No WebSocket, no Supabase Realtime, no remote sync yet**

#### **SDK Integration** (`/sdk/index.js`)
```javascript
// Apps/agents call:
const result = await callAgent('quill', 'prompt')

// Which does:
fetch('http://localhost:3847/api/playground/run', { /* ... */ })
  // Reads response as Server-Sent Events
  // Parses 'data: {...}' lines
```

---

### **4. Hosting Config — What Exists**

**Files present:**
- ✓ `package.json` with `"start": "node src/server.js"` and `"dev"` script
- ✓ `ecosystem.config.js` — PM2 config (for daemon mode)
- ✗ NO `Dockerfile` — not containerized
- ✗ NO `railway.json` / `railway.toml` — not configured for Railway
- ✗ NO `Procfile` or deployment manifests
- ✗ NO environment variable `.env.example`

**Config Storage:** `config.json` in project root (NOT version controlled)
```json
{
  "projectDirs": ["~/Desktop/Boldteq App"],
  "backup": { "repoUrl": "...", "tokenEnc": "..." }
}
```

---

### **5. Data Sync Requirements**

**Local state needing sync to cloud:**
- `agent_runs` table — execution history & metrics
- `daily_scores` — performance snapshots
- `agents` table — agent definitions & metadata
- `orchestrations.json` — workflow definitions
- `agent-versions/` — snapshot history
- `~/.claude/` directory changes — agents, memory, rules (already backed up to GitHub)

**Current persistence:** All in SQLite + GitHub backup via Chokidar

---

### **6. VS Code Extension**

**Status:** Built but dormant
- Location: `/vscode-extension/`
- Package: `claude-hub-0.1.0.vsix` pre-built
- Files: TypeScript source in `/src/`
- **Purpose:** Local extension to VS Code (not a web-based extension)
- **NOT integrated** into the server — separate package

---

### **7. Root Directory Structure**

```
Polyglot/
├── src/                          # Backend (Express server)
│   ├── server.js                 # Entry point
│   ├── db.js                     # SQLite schema & queries
│   ├── backup.js                 # GitHub backup + Chokidar watcher
│   ├── routes/                   # 20+ API endpoints
│   │   ├── agents.js, rules.js, projects.js
│   │   ├── playground.js         # Agent execution (SSE)
│   │   ├── dispatch.js           # Agent-to-agent calls
│   │   ├── schedules.js, webhooks.js
│   │   └── ...
│   ├── middleware/               # CORS, security, localOnly
│   └── lib/                      # Discovery, config, validation
├── client/                       # React frontend (Vite)
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── App.tsx
│   │   ├── pages/                # Dashboard views
│   │   ├── components/           # UI reusables
│   │   └── lib/                  # API client
│   └── package.json
├── sdk/                          # @boldteq/agents npm module
│   ├── index.js                  # Exports: callAgent, etc.
│   ├── index.d.ts                # TypeScript definitions
│   └── package.json              # name: "@boldteq/agents"
├── vscode-extension/             # VS Code integration
│   ├── src/
│   └── package.json
├── data/                         # Runtime (SQLite db)
│   └── polyglot.db               # ← Created on first run
├── public-dist/                  # Built React assets
├── package.json                  # Root: "main": "src/server.js"
├── config.json                   # User config (local projects dir, backup token)
├── README.md                     # Setup instructions
└── CLAUDE.md                     # Empty (no rules yet)
```

---

### **8. Key Findings for "Real-Time Sync to Railway"**

**What would need to be hosted:**
1. **Express Server** — move to Railway
2. **SQLite → Postgres** — Railway-hosted database (or Supabase)
3. **File Watcher → Remote Sync** — Chokidar stays local, but changes sync to remote DB
4. **GitHub Backup → Remote Backup** — Already works, but Cloud backup redundancy needed

**What stays local:**
- React frontend (can be served by Railway or kept as SPA)
- Agent SDK (@boldteq/agents) — stays in `Polyglot/sdk/` as npm module
- VS Code extension — remains local

**Communication flow (with Railway hosting):**
```
Your Mac
├─ Polyglot Server (Railway: polyglot.railway.app)
│  ├─ Express API
│  ├─ Postgres/Supabase DB (cloud)
│  └─ File watcher (local → sync to REST API)
├─ React UI (served by Railway OR locally)
├─ Agent SDK
│  └─ Calls polyglot.railway.app/api/*  ← HTTPS
└─ GitHub Backup (encrypted token)
```

**What "real-time sync" means for this system:**
- **Local changes** (`~/.claude/` files) detected by Chokidar → batched REST API calls to Railway
- **Database changes** on Railway → React client polls `/api/*` for updates (currently no subscriptions)
- **Agent runs** logged to Railway Postgres in real-time
- **Backup** still to GitHub (independent of Railway)

---

### **Referenced Spec**

The memory file `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/memory/patterns/good/polyglot-sdk-spec.md` describes a **future design** with:
- Supabase `agent-ops` database for all agents
- Real-time Supabase subscriptions
- 22+ agents with event streaming

**Status:** That spec is aspirational (2026-04). The current Polyglot is a **local SQLite version** that doesn't yet implement that cloud-based SDK spec.

---

## Summary

| Aspect | Today | For Railway Hosting |
|--------|-------|-------------------|
| **Type** | Local dashboard + SDK | Distributed system |
| **Server** | localhost:3847 | Railway.app HTTPS |
| **Database** | SQLite (local) | Postgres/Supabase (cloud) |
| **File Watching** | Chokidar (local) | Local → REST sync |
| **Backups** | GitHub (encrypted token) | GitHub + Cloud redundancy |
| **Real-Time** | None (REST polling) | Need WebSocket or SSE from server |
| **Security** | localhost enforcement | API keys, CORS, auth tokens |

**File paths key to hosting migration:**
- Server entry: `/src/server.js` 
- Database layer: `/src/db.js` (SQLite → need Postgres adapter)
- Backup system: `/src/backup.js` (already sync-capable, needs cloud target)
- SDK client: `/sdk/index.js` (needs remote URL env var)
